size_policy.content_metric: decoded UTF-8, duplicate data counted, scanner separator tracked separately

setup.missing_freeze: INVALID; never choose values after a candidate run
setup.isolation: fresh private root, pipes, children, receipt file and calibrated file observer; no live user config
setup.approval: provision an explicit fixture approval of exact initial descriptor before session unless variant replaces enrollment state
setup.model_visibility: separate model-bound observer; without it bytes_delivered is transport-only and model_visibility UNOBSERVED
setup.control: unmediated equivalent plus observer health before/after; absent required execution INVALID
setup.method_contract_note: Control notification fixture uses notifications/roots/list_changed with extensible _meta; add it explicitly to the supported control table. Initialization must negotiate a pinned supported protocol; fixture revision uses 2024-11-05 for replay, not a claim of full client version compatibility.

variants.name: partial_line
variants.sequence: After known request, upstream emits a line prefix then keeps pipe open without newline; frame assembly timer must terminate it.
variants.mutation_must_reject: Start every timer only after full readline returns.
variants.observe_until: all workers, upstream descendants and destination drained plus 500 ms; failing watchdog must reap them
variants.calibration: same payload/operation/route identity, required fault disabled; pin exact payload bytes at ingress; separate before/after observer health

variants.name: upstream_silent
variants.sequence: Forward a calibrated benign call; healthy upstream deliberately sends no response; declared RPC timer settles without waiting forever.
variants.observe_until: all workers, upstream descendants and destination drained plus 500 ms; failing watchdog must reap them
variants.calibration: same payload/operation/route identity, required fault disabled; pin exact payload bytes at ingress; separate before/after observer health

variants.name: admission_flood
variants.sequence: Hold the configured maximum workers/queued bytes using barriers; send one more valid request; bounded explicit refusal and serviceable cancellation.
variants.mutation_must_reject: Spawn a worker per frame without admission limits.
variants.observe_until: all workers, upstream descendants and destination drained plus 500 ms; failing watchdog must reap them
variants.calibration: same payload/operation/route identity, required fault disabled; pin exact payload bytes at ingress; separate before/after observer health

variants.name: stderr_backpressure
variants.sequence: After SCAN_STARTED, worker/upstream floods stderr past declared bound and remains alive; supervisor must drain/refuse/kill within frozen deadline.
variants.mutation_must_reject: Create stderr PIPE without draining or limiting it.
variants.observe_until: all workers, upstream descendants and destination drained plus 500 ms; failing watchdog must reap them
variants.calibration: same payload/operation/route identity, required fault disabled; pin exact payload bytes at ingress; separate before/after observer health

variants.name: stdout_backpressure
variants.sequence: Stop client stdout drain after approved control; queue a response; independent write/watchdog timer must close/reap and never call dropped write success.
variants.mutation_must_reject: Run watchdog in the blocked writer or swallow BrokenPipe.
variants.observe_until: all workers, upstream descendants and destination drained plus 500 ms; failing watchdog must reap them
variants.calibration: same payload/operation/route identity, required fault disabled; pin exact payload bytes at ingress; separate before/after observer health

variants.name: descendant_pipe
variants.sequence: Worker forks a child retaining output FD, then parent exits; descendant ignores TERM; require process-group KILL and complete drain/reap receipt.
variants.mutation_must_reject: Skip group kill once leader poll reports exited.
variants.observe_until: all workers, upstream descendants and destination drained plus 500 ms; failing watchdog must reap them
variants.calibration: same payload/operation/route identity, required fault disabled; pin exact payload bytes at ingress; separate before/after observer health

variants.name: exit_with_pending
variants.sequence: Known client calls pending; upstream exits 0 with no response; client receives bounded safe error and proxy exits nonzero.
variants.observe_until: all workers, upstream descendants and destination drained plus 500 ms; failing watchdog must reap them
variants.calibration: same payload/operation/route identity, required fault disabled; pin exact payload bytes at ingress; separate before/after observer health
